journey.name: Rick And Morty Journey
journey.description: A Journey that tests going to character detail -> episode detail

actions.action: Pick a random character and click it. This should take you to the character detail screen.
Wait until the character detail is loaded. Click the "Episodes" button. You might need to scroll down to see the "Episodes" button.
Scroll down to see the list of episodes.
Click a random episode. This should take you to the episode detail screen. There should be some info about the episode as well as list of characters that appered in it.
